name: Vera 05 · 08 Set up a new site

parameters.content:
## Vera 05 · 08 Set up a new site
The engineer (or planning) fills one form: site, contractor, dates, contract value, peak labour, phones. Vera creates the checklist, sends the contractor the area prompts, and sends the engineer his walk link.

Generated from `n8n/mobilise/workflows.mjs`. Edit there and rebuild; edits made here are overwritten on the next import.
Each node's note says what it does and which guardrails it carries.

nodes.name: New site form

parameters.formDescription: Five minutes, once per site. Vera uses these facts to check every paper the contractor sends.

values.fieldLabel: Other spellings of the contractor name
Address words that must appear on papers
Shadow mode: a person confirms every AI filing

nodes.notes:
An n8n form behind login. No spreadsheet to keep in sync.
Guardrails: auth

nodes.name: Check the form
nodes.notes:
Dates in order, numbers are numbers, phones have country code.
Guardrails: schema

nodes.name: Form OK?
nodes.notes: Wrong input stops here, with reasons.

nodes.name: Copy checklist for this site
nodes.notes: Template mob-v1: only the lines that apply (plant or RMC, crane, creche, excavation).

nodes.name: Create site, lines, contacts
nodes.notes:
All in one statement: either the whole site is created or nothing is.
Guardrails: audit

nodes.name: Build area prompts
nodes.notes: One message per area, each listing its lines by number.

nodes.name: Send area prompts
nodes.notes: The first one goes as the welcome template (outside the 24 h window); the contractor's reply opens the window for the rest.

nodes.name: Sign the walk link
nodes.notes:
Signed link for the engineer, valid until the day after the visit.
Guardrails: auth
